item.title: 2026 Prayer Breakfast
item.ns1:encoded:
Join Us for a Breakfast of Faith and Community

Friday, November 20th | 7:30 AM

Join the YMCA of Columbia for our annual Prayer Breakfast, a heartwarming event that brings our community together to celebrate faith and support those in need. We are honored to feature this year’s keynote speaker, Dr. Bill Jones, President of Columbia International University (CIU).

For Dr. Bill Jones, putting faith into action has meant a lifetime of serving others, developing leaders, and sharing God’s love both locally and around the world. As president of CIU and co-founder of Crossover Global, a mission organization that has helped plant more than 7,000 churches among unreached populations worldwide. He has dedicated decades to creating opportunities, strengthening communities, and helping others live out their faith through meaningful service.

Event Details:

  • Date: Friday, November 20th
  • Time: 7:30 AM (doors and breakfast buffet open) | 8:00 AM (program begins)
  • Location: State Fair Grounds, Moore Building (Near the Rocket) 1200 Rosewood Dr, Columbia, SC 29201
  • Tickets: Individual Tickets $35 each (Purchase Now) | Table Sponsorships Listed Below (Purchase Now)

Proceeds from the Prayer Breakfast will benefit our Annual Campaign, which provides essential programs and services to families in our community who need them most.

Don’t miss this opportunity to connect with your neighbors, enjoy a delicious breakfast, and be inspired by powerful messages from community prayer leaders.

item.title: Go the Distance with the 50 Mile Swim Club
item.ns1:encoded:
Make this season one to remember—join the YMCA of Columbia’s 50 Mile Swim Club and challenge yourself to swim 50 miles at your own pace.

How It Works

  • Swim a total of 50 miles between October 1st and December 31st!

  • Log your laps on using our online tracker.

  • All swim styles and techniques count—freestyle, butterfly, backstroke, breaststroke, or even dog paddle!

Registration Details

  • Cost: $20 per participant

  • Perk: Everyone who completes the challenge receives an official 50 Mile Swim Club t-shirt

  • Register (Click on Links Below):

    • Jeep Rogers Family YMCA (Lake Carolina)

    • Northwest Family YMCA (Irmo)

    • Orangeburg County YMCA (St. Matthews Road)

Why Join?

  • Motivation – A clear goal to keep you swimming strong.

  • Community – Train alongside other members and celebrate milestones together.

  • Recognition – Finishers earn bragging rights, recognition, and their official swim club shirt to show it off.

So grab your goggles, dive in, and start logging your miles. Whether you swim for fitness, fun, or personal achievement, the 50 Mile Swim Club is your chance to go the distance.

Register today at your local YMCA branch and start your journey to 50 miles!

item.title: 2026 Pack the Park for Nonprofits!
item.ns1:encoded:
Pack the Park for Nonprofits: Cheer on the Fireflies While Supporting the YMCA

Baseball fans, this is your chance to enjoy a great night at the ballpark while making a difference in our community.

Join the YMCA of Columbia on Tuesday, August 25, as we team up with the Columbia Fireflies for Pack the Park for Nonprofits. Every ticket purchased through the YMCA’s special event link helps support our mission, with $5 from each ticket benefiting the YMCA of Columbia’s Annual Campaign.

Whether you’re planning a family outing, a night with friends, or a team event, you’ll be helping ensure that everyone in our community has access to YMCA programs that strengthen youth, improve health, and support families—regardless of their ability to pay.

Event Details

  • Date: Tuesday, August 25
  • Game Time: 7:05 PM
  • Gates Open: 6:00 PM
  • Location: Segra Park, 1640 Freed Street, Columbia, SC 29201

Every Ticket Makes a Difference

When you purchase your tickets through the YMCA’s Pack the Park fundraiser, $5 from every ticket sold goes directly to the YMCA of Columbia’s Annual Campaign. These funds help provide financial assistance for memberships, swim lessons, youth sports, afterschool care, summer camp, and other life-changing programs for children, adults, and families throughout our community.

Bring Your Friends and Family

There’s nothing like a summer evening at the ballpark. Come enjoy America’s favorite pastime, connect with the community, and help the YMCA continue creating opportunities for everyone to learn, grow, and thrive.

We hope to see the stands filled with YMCA members, volunteers, staff, and supporters as we Pack the Park for Nonprofits!

Get your tickets today and help make a lasting impact—one ticket at a time.

PURCHASE TICKETS

item.title: 2026 Annual Campaign Results
item.ns1:encoded:
Community Support Fuels YMCA of Columbia’s Mission

The YMCA of Columbia is grateful for the generosity of our members, volunteers, staff, and community supporters who contributed to the 2026 Annual Campaign.

This year, 275 donors pledged $74,159 in support of the YMCA’s mission to strengthen spirit, mind, and body for all. To date, $61,173 has been received, helping ensure that individuals and families throughout the Midlands have access to YMCA programs and services regardless of their ability to pay.

Support came from across the association, with donors investing in the communities served by each YMCA branch:

  • Ballentine Family YMCA: 3 donors pledged $1,600
  • Downtown YMCA: 47 donors pledged $31,494
  • Northwest Family YMCA: 52 donors pledged $10,642
  • Jeep Rogers Family YMCA: 94 donors pledged $10,419
  • Orangeburg County YMCA: 47 donors pledged $6,185
  • Association Giving: 32 donors pledged $13,819

Every contribution helps provide financial assistance, youth development programs, wellness opportunities, and community outreach initiatives that positively impact lives throughout our region.

The spirit of giving continued during Midlands Gives, where an additional $2,700 was raised from 18 donors. These gifts further support the YMCA’s efforts to create opportunities for children, families, and seniors across the communities we serve.

While the Annual Campaign has concluded, the opportunity to make a difference continues throughout the year. Donations can be made year-round, helping the YMCA respond to community needs and provide programs that strengthen individuals and families every day.

As a special thank you, donors who contributed $75 or more to the Annual Campaign can pick up their campaign t-shirt at their local YMCA branch.

The YMCA of Columbia extends its sincere appreciation to every donor who invested in our mission. Together, we are building a stronger, healthier, and more connected community.

DONATE Today!

item.title: 3v3 Basketball Tournament at Orangeburg County YMCA
item.ns1:encoded:
Bring Your Team and Battle for the Title in Our 3v3 Basketball Tournament

If you’re looking for fast-paced competition and exciting basketball action, our 3v3 Basketball Tournament is the place to be. This dynamic format puts the spotlight on teamwork, skill, strategy, and hustle. With fewer players on the court, every pass, rebound, and shot becomes even more important, creating an intense and entertaining experience for players and spectators alike.

Schedule

  • Mondays | 6:00–8:00 PM
  • July 6
  • July 13
  • July 20
  • July 27

Age Divisions

  • 15–17
  • 18–24
  • 25–34
  • 35+

Registration Information

All participants must register as part of a complete team. Individual player registrations will not be accepted, and teams will not be formed by tournament staff. It is the responsibility of each team to assemble its roster and complete registration before the July 4 deadline.

Tournament Format

The tournament structure will be determined after registration closes and team totals are finalized. Depending on the number of teams in each division, competition formats may include pool play, round-robin play, single-elimination, double-elimination, or a combination of formats designed to provide the best possible competitive experience. Final schedules and brackets will be released once all teams have been confirmed.

Whether you’re playing for fun, looking to test your skills, or chasing championship bragging rights, this tournament offers an exciting opportunity to compete against some of the area’s top talent.

Don’t miss your chance to compete. Assemble your roster, choose your division, and register your team today. Spots are limited, and once registration closes, the road to the championship begins. Will your team rise to the challenge and claim the title?

Register Now!

item.title: 2026 Annual Campaign – The All In, All Together Place
item.ns1:encoded:
Donate to the 2026 YMCA of Columbia Annual Campaign

At the YMCA of Columbia, we believe this is The All In, All Together Place—a place where everyone belongs and has the opportunity to thrive. Our Annual Campaign is a vital effort that provides scholarships for individuals and families who cannot afford YMCA memberships and programs.

When you give, you help remove financial barriers—ensuring children, families, and individuals have access to health, connection, and personal growth. Because there is truly No Place Like This Place.

Donate Today

Who Does It Help?

Every dollar raised goes directly to those in need. Your donation supports:

  • Children in afterschool and summer camp programs
  • Families who need financial assistance for memberships
  • Seniors and individuals seeking wellness opportunities
  • Youth looking to build confidence through sports and swim programs

In 2025 alone, thanks to generous donors like you:

  • 529 children received afterschool program scholarships
  • 368 kids experienced the joy of summer camp
  • 180 memberships were made possible for those in need
  • 112 youth participated in swim and sports programs with financial assistance

When is the Annual Campaign?

Year-round support makes our work possible, but our Annual Campaign—April 20 through May 5—is when our community comes together in a big way, beginning with Day of Giving and ending with Midlands Gives.

What are Your Giving Levels?

Your YMCA membership supports daily operations, but your donation helps ensure access, opportunity, and belonging for those who need it most. This is the All In, All Together Place—and there is truly No Place Like This Place.

  • Donate $5 or more – Receive a YMCA tote (while supplies last)
  • Donate $75 or more – Receive a commemorative YMCA 175th Anniversary t-shirt

Give today and help build a stronger, healthier, and more connected community.

Donate Today
